mapper.sql: id, owner_type as ownerType, owner_id as ownerId, out_request_no as outRequestNo, applyment_id as applymentId, applyment_state as applymentState, applyment_state_desc as applymentStateDesc, sign_url as signUrl, sub_mchid as subMchid, last_queried_at as lastQueriedAt, created_by as createdBy, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.select: select from ecom_sub_merchant where owner_type = #{ownerType} and owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_sub_merchant (owner_type, owner_id, out_request_no, applyment_state, created_by) values (#{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{outRequestNo}, 'DRAFT', #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update ecom_sub_merchant set applyment_id = #{applymentId}, applyment_state = 'CHECKING' where id = #{id} and applyment_state = 'DRAFT'

update ecom_sub_merchant set applyment_state = #{state}, applyment_state_desc = #{stateDesc}, sign_url = #{signUrl}, sub_mchid = coalesce(sub_mchid, #{subMchid}), applyment_id = coalesce(applyment_id, #{applymentId}), last_queried_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = #{id} and applyment_state = #{expectedState} and (sub_mchid is null or #{subMchid} is null or sub_mchid = #{subMchid})
mapper.select: select e.sub_mchid from ecom_sub_merchant e join mms_merchant m on e.owner_type = 'MERCHANT' and e.owner_id = m.id where m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.del_flag = 0 and e.applyment_state = 'FINISH' and e.sub_mchid is not null union select e.sub_mchid from ecom_sub_merchant e join club c on e.owner_type = 'CLUB' and e.owner_id = c.id where c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.del_flag = 0 and e.applyment_state = 'FINISH' and e.sub_mchid is not null

choose.when: select member_id from mms_merchant where id = #{ownerId} and del_flag = 0
choose.otherwise: select member_id from club where id = #{ownerId} and del_flag = 0

mapper.insert: insert into ecom_order_seller (out_trade_no, sub_mchid, seller_type, seller_id, total_fen) values (#{outTradeNo}, #{subMchid}, #{sellerType}, #{sellerId}, #{totalFen})
mapper.select: select out_trade_no as outTradeNo, sub_mchid as subMchid, seller_type as sellerType, seller_id as sellerId, total_fen as totalFen, transaction_id as transactionId from ecom_order_seller where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
mapper.update: update ecom_order_seller set transaction_id = #{transactionId} where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and transaction_id is null
mapper.select: select s.out_trade_no as outTradeNo, s.sub_mchid as subMchid, s.seller_type as sellerType, s.seller_id as sellerId, s.total_fen as totalFen, s.transaction_id as transactionId, r.id as registrationId from cms_registration r join ecom_order_seller s on CAST(s.out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(r.registration_no AS BINARY) where r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{topicId} and s.transaction_id is not null order by r.id

select settlement_id as settlementId, line_type as lineType, receiver_kind as receiverKind, receiver_member_id as receiverMemberId, original_amount as originalAmount from coop_settlement_original_component where topic_id = #{topicId} and payer_registration_id = #{payerRegistrationId} order by settlement_id, id
mapper.sql: id, out_order_no as outOrderNo, out_trade_no as outTradeNo, topic_id as topicId, sub_mchid as subMchid, transaction_id as transactionId, total_fen as totalFen, shared_fen as sharedFen, plan_hash as planHash, state, manual_reason as manualReason, wx_order_id as wxOrderId, attempts
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_profit_share_order (out_order_no, out_trade_no, topic_id, sub_mchid, transaction_id, total_fen, shared_fen, plan_hash, state, manual_reason) values (#{outOrderNo}, #{outTradeNo}, #{topicId}, #{subMchid}, #{transactionId}, #{totalFen}, #{sharedFen}, #{planHash}, #{state}, #{manualReason})
mapper.select: select from ecom_profit_share_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and topic_id = #{topicId}
select from ecom_profit_share_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} order by id
select from ecom_profit_share_order where state = #{state} order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ecom_profit_share_order set state = #{state}, wx_order_id = coalesce(#{wxOrderId}, wx_order_id), manual_reason = #{manualReason}, attempts = attempts + 1 where id = #{id} and state = #{expectedState}
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_profit_share_line (share_order_id, settlement_id, line_type, receiver_kind, receiver_mchid, receiver_member_id, amount_fen) values (#{shareOrderId}, #{settlementId}, #{lineType}, #{receiverKind}, #{receiverMchid}, #{receiverMemberId}, #{amountFen})
mapper.select: select id, share_order_id as shareOrderId, settlement_id as settlementId, line_type as lineType, receiver_kind as receiverKind, receiver_mchid as receiverMchid, receiver_member_id as receiverMemberId, amount_fen as amountFen from ecom_profit_share_line where share_order_id = #{shareOrderId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_profit_share_return (out_return_no, share_order_id, out_refund_no, return_mchid, amount_fen, state) values (#{outReturnNo}, #{shareOrderId}, #{outRefundNo}, #{returnMchid}, #{amountFen}, 'PROCESSING')
mapper.select: select id, out_return_no as outReturnNo, share_order_id as shareOrderId, out_refund_no as outRefundNo, return_mchid as returnMchid, amount_fen as amountFen, state, wx_return_no as wxReturnNo, fail_reason as failReason from ecom_profit_share_return where out_return_no = #{outReturnNo}

select id, out_return_no as outReturnNo, share_order_id as shareOrderId, out_refund_no as outRefundNo, return_mchid as returnMchid, amount_fen as amountFen, state, wx_return_no as wxReturnNo, fail_reason as failReason from ecom_profit_share_return where share_order_id = #{shareOrderId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into creator_payout_request (out_payout_no, creator_member_id, source_type, source_id, amount_fen, provider, state) values (#{outPayoutNo}, #{creatorMemberId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{amountFen}, #{provider}, 'REQUESTED')
